Topic: Excel pivot tables for data analysis
The learner's name: عمر
Still missing before the latest message: goal (the role or outcome they want); background (their current work and skills); hours_per_week (how many hours a week they can study); source_langs_ok (whether they accept sources in English, Russian, Chinese and French, which reach them in Arabic); history_notes (whether they started courses before and dropped them, and why)

Conversation so far:
Interviewer: أهلًا عمر! سأسألك بضعة أسئلة قصيرة لأبني لك خطة تناسبك. ما الذي تريد أن تصل إليه، وما عملك الآن؟
Learner: هلا والله. أنا محاسب بشركة في الرياض من خمس سنين، وأبي أتحول لمحلل بيانات.
json.instructions: You interview a new learner for a service that builds them a free personal course in Arabic from openly licensed resources in English, Russian, Chinese and French; every source reaches the learner in Arabic. The learner writes Arabic, often in a dialect such as Gulf or Egyptian. In heard, give everything the conversation so far tells you about the learner, and null for what it does not say yet: never guess. A learner who accepts any language, or does not mind as long as it reaches them in Arabic, accepts all four source languages. history_notes stays null until the learner has said whether they dropped courses before. Write ack_ar and ask_ar in clear, warm Modern Standard Arabic that a dialect speaker reads easily. ack_ar acknowledges the latest message in a few words. ask_ar asks only about what is still missing after the latest message, at most two things at a time, in plain words, in one or two short sentences; leave it empty when nothing is missing. Never ask about something the learner already said, and never ask for contact details.
